name: reporter_cluster_boxplot_handbook
description: Complete handbook test for Boxplot family reporters: boxplot (L1-L6, L9-L12), cs_boxplot (L1-L5, L6-L9). 21 layouts total, each in its own category.
source:
# ========================================================================
# Boxplot Family Handbook — All Layouts
# Assets: SPY, QQQ, DIA | Timeframe: 1D
# ========================================================================

# === Market Data ===
src = study_assets()
close = src.c
high = src.h
low = src.l

# === Core Derived Series ===
daily_ret = (close - (close >> 1)) / (close >> 1)
sma_20 = sma(close, 20)
sma_50 = sma(close, 50)
sma_200 = sma(close, 200)
ts = index()

# Date components
month_num = datetime_extract(component=DatetimeExtractionType.month)(ts)
dow = datetime_extract(component=DatetimeExtractionType.day_of_week)(ts)

# Intraday range as percent
intraday_range = (high - low) / close

# ========================================================================
# BOXPLOT (per-asset) — L1 through L6
# ========================================================================

# L1: Grouped — daily returns by month (basic)
boxplot(
    mode=BoxplotMode.grouped,
    title='L1: Daily Return Distribution by Month',
    category='01 boxplot L1: Grouped Basic',
    x_category_type=CategoryAxisType.Month,
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    outlier_color=Color.Yellow
)(values=daily_ret, label=month_num)

# L2: Grouped — daily returns by day-of-week
boxplot(
    mode=BoxplotMode.grouped,
    title='L2: Daily Return Distribution by Weekday',
    category='02 boxplot L2: Grouped DayOfWeek',
    x_category_type=CategoryAxisType.DayOfWeek,
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    outlier_color=Color.Yellow
)(values=daily_ret, label=dow)

# L3: Grouped — styled (custom colors, median styling)
boxplot(
    mode=BoxplotMode.grouped,
    title='L3: Styled Monthly Returns',
    category='03 boxplot L3: Grouped Styling',
    x_category_type=CategoryAxisType.Month,
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    fill_color=Color.Sky,
    median_color=Color.Red,
    median_width=3,
    stem_color=Color.Gray,
    whisker_color=Color.Indigo,
    outlier_color=Color.Orange
)(values=daily_ret, label=month_num)

# L4: Variadic — compare SMA distributions side-by-side
boxplot(
    mode=BoxplotMode.variadic,
    title='L4: SMA Distributions Compared',
    category='04 boxplot L4: Variadic',
    series_names=['SMA 20', 'SMA 50', 'SMA 200'],
    outlier_color=Color.Yellow
)(values=(sma_20, sma_50, sma_200))

# L5: Grouped — wider whiskers, no outliers
boxplot(
    mode=BoxplotMode.grouped,
    title='L5: Monthly Returns (Wide Whiskers, No Outliers)',
    category='05 boxplot L5: Outlier Control',
    x_category_type=CategoryAxisType.Month,
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    whisker_iqr=3.0,
    show_outliers=False
)(values=daily_ret, label=month_num)

# L6: Grouped — with data labels and percent format
boxplot(
    mode=BoxplotMode.grouped,
    title='L6: Monthly Returns with Median Labels',
    category='06 boxplot L6: Data Labels',
    x_category_type=CategoryAxisType.Month,
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    outlier_color=Color.Yellow
)(values=daily_ret, label=month_num)

# ========================================================================
# CS_BOXPLOT (cross-sectional) — L1 through L4
# ========================================================================

# L1: Simple — one box per asset (daily returns)
cs_boxplot(
    mode=CSBoxplotMode.simple,
    title='L1: Daily Return Distribution by Asset',
    category='07 cs_boxplot L1: Simple',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    outlier_color=Color.Yellow
)(values=daily_ret)

# L2: Simple — custom colors per asset
cs_boxplot(
    mode=CSBoxplotMode.simple,
    title='L2: Daily Returns (Custom Colors)',
    category='08 cs_boxplot L2: Custom Colors',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    colors=[Color.Blue, Color.Indigo, Color.Gray],
    outlier_color=Color.Yellow
)(values=daily_ret)

# L3: Multi-metric — return + intraday range per asset
cs_boxplot(
    mode=CSBoxplotMode.multi_metric,
    title='L3: Return vs Intraday Range by Asset',
    category='09 cs_boxplot L3: Multi-Metric',
    metric_names=['Daily Return', 'Intraday Range'],
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    outlier_color=Color.Yellow
)(values=(daily_ret, intraday_range))

# L4: Simple — max_assets limit
cs_boxplot(
    mode=CSBoxplotMode.simple,
    title='L4: Top 2 Assets Return Distribution',
    category='10 cs_boxplot L4: Filtered',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    max_assets=2,
    outlier_color=Color.Yellow
)(values=daily_ret)

# ========================================================================
# ADDITIONAL LAYOUTS — Enum Diversity
# ========================================================================

# L7: Grouped — decimal format (SMA levels by month)
boxplot(
    mode=BoxplotMode.grouped,
    title='L7: SMA 20 Distribution by Month (Decimal)',
    category='11 boxplot L7: DecimalFormat',
    x_category_type=CategoryAxisType.Month,
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    outlier_color=Color.Yellow
)(values=sma_20, label=month_num)

# L8: Variadic — monetary format (close price distributions)
boxplot(
    mode=BoxplotMode.variadic,
    title='L8: Close Price Distributions (Monetary)',
    category='12 boxplot L8: MonetaryFormat',
    series_names=['SMA 20', 'SMA 50', 'SMA 200'],
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.MonetaryFormat,
    fill_color=Color.Emerald,
    median_color=Color.Red,
    outlier_color=Color.Orange
)(values=(sma_20, sma_50, sma_200))

# L5: Simple — BpsFormat (intraday range auto-scaled x10000)
cs_boxplot(
    mode=CSBoxplotMode.simple,
    title='L5: Intraday Range by Asset (Bps)',
    category='13 cs_boxplot L5: BpsFormat',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.BpsFormat,
    outlier_color=Color.Yellow
)(values=intraday_range)



# ========================================================================
# NEW FEATURE LAYOUTS — Reference Lines, Sort, Horizontal, Plot Bands
# ========================================================================

# L9: Grouped — with reference lines (zero return line)
boxplot(
    mode=BoxplotMode.grouped,
    title='L9: Monthly Returns with Reference Lines',
    category='14 boxplot L9: Reference Lines',
    x_category_type=CategoryAxisType.Month,
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, title='Zero Line', color=Color.Red, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ]),
    outlier_color=Color.Yellow
)(values=daily_ret, label=month_num)

# L10: Grouped — sorted by median descending
boxplot(
    mode=BoxplotMode.grouped,
    title='L10: Monthly Returns Sorted by Median',
    category='15 boxplot L10: Sort By Value',
    x_category_type=CategoryAxisType.Month,
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    sort_by_value=SortByValue.Descending,
    outlier_color=Color.Yellow
)(values=daily_ret, label=month_num)

# L11: Grouped — horizontal orientation
boxplot(
    mode=BoxplotMode.grouped,
    title='L11: Monthly Returns (Horizontal)',
    category='16 boxplot L11: Horizontal',
    x_category_type=CategoryAxisType.Month,
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    vertical=False,
    outlier_color=Color.Yellow
)(values=daily_ret, label=month_num)

# L12: Grouped — with Y plot bands (highlighting +/- 2% zone)
boxplot(
    mode=BoxplotMode.grouped,
    title='L12: Monthly Returns with Plot Bands',
    category='17 boxplot L12: Y Plot Bands',
    x_category_type=CategoryAxisType.Month,
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    y_plot_bands=PlotBandSchema(bands=[
        PlotBand(from=-2.0, to=2.0, color=Color.Green, opacity=0.15, label='Normal Range')
    ]),
    outlier_color=Color.Yellow
)(values=daily_ret, label=month_num)

# cs_L6: Simple — with reference lines
cs_boxplot(
    mode=CSBoxplotMode.simple,
    title='L6: Daily Returns with Reference Line',
    category='18 cs_boxplot L6: Reference Lines',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, title='Zero', color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dot)
    ]),
    outlier_color=Color.Yellow
)(values=daily_ret)

# cs_L7: Simple — sorted by median ascending
cs_boxplot(
    mode=CSBoxplotMode.simple,
    title='L7: Daily Returns Sorted by Median',
    category='19 cs_boxplot L7: Sort By Value',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    sort_by_value=SortByValue.Ascending,
    outlier_color=Color.Yellow
)(values=daily_ret)

# cs_L8: Simple — horizontal orientation
cs_boxplot(
    mode=CSBoxplotMode.simple,
    title='L8: Daily Returns (Horizontal)',
    category='20 cs_boxplot L8: Horizontal',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    vertical=False,
    outlier_color=Color.Yellow
)(values=daily_ret)

# cs_L9: Simple — with Y plot bands
cs_boxplot(
    mode=CSBoxplotMode.simple,
    title='L9: Daily Returns with Plot Bands',
    category='21 cs_boxplot L9: Y Plot Bands',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    y_plot_bands=PlotBandSchema(bands=[
        PlotBand(from=-1.0, to=1.0, color=Color.Blue, opacity=0.1, label='Tight Range')
    ]),
    outlier_color=Color.Yellow
)(values=daily_ret)
